UK SmPC adds: carbamazepine is absorbed almost completely but relatively slowly; conventional tablets yield mean peak plasma concentrations within 12 hours (chewable tablets 6 hours; syrup 2 hours); after a single oral dose of 400 mg, mean peak concentration is approx. 4.5 micrograms/mL; bioavailability 85-100%; steady-state attained within about 1-2 weeks depending on autoinduction; apparent volume of distribution 0.8 to 1.9 L/kg; protein binding 70-80% (CSF and saliva reflect non-protein-bound 20-30%); elimination half-life averages approx. 36 hours after a single dose, 16-24 hours after repeated administration, and averaging 9-10 hours with concomitant enzyme-inducing drugs (phenytoin, phenobarbitone); the 10,11-epoxide metabolite half-life is about 6 hours; in the urine about 2% of the dose is recovered as unchanged drug and about 1% as the epoxide; ingestion of food has no significant influence on the rate and extent of absorption; steady-state 'therapeutic range' 4-12 micrograms/mL (17-50 micromol/L); the 10,11-epoxide metabolite is pharmacologically active at about 30% of carbamazepine levels; children may require higher doses (mg/kg) than adults due to enhanced elimination; no indication of altered pharmacokinetics in the elderly; no data are available on pharmacokinetics in impaired hepatic or renal function (Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, sections 4.2, 5.2).
clinical_pearls: Tegretol labeling carries two boxed warnings: serious dermatologic reactions (TEN/SJS, with HLA-B*1502 screening recommended for at-risk Asian ancestry populations) and aplastic anemia/agranulocytosis (risk 5-8 times general population). Both must be discussed with patients before starting (Tegretol US PI, BOXED WARNING).

Screen before prescribing: patients of Han Chinese, Thai, and other at-risk Asian ancestry should be tested for HLA-B*1502 before starting; over 90% of patients who develop SJS/TEN with Tegretol do so within the first few months of treatment (Tegretol US PI, WARNINGS - SJS/TEN and HLA-B*1502 Allele; Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, section 4.2).

Carbamazepine is a potent autoinducer: initial half-life 25-65 hours falls to 12-17 hours on repeated dosing, with autoinduction complete after 3-5 weeks; expect plasma levels to fall over the first weeks at a fixed dose - recheck levels if seizures emerge late in the first month (Tegretol US PI, CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY - Pharmacokinetics).

Usual adult therapeutic plasma range is 4-12 mcg/mL; monitor levels particularly in cases of dramatic increase in seizure frequency, verification of compliance, pregnancy, children/adolescents, suspected absorption problems, or polypharmacy toxicity (Tegretol US PI, CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY - Pharmacokinetics and PRECAUTIONS - Laboratory Tests; Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, sections 4.2 and 4.4).

Enzyme induction has two-way consequences: carbamazepine lowers hormonal contraceptive levels (breakthrough bleeding, unintended pregnancies - advise alternative/back-up contraception, or >=50 microgram oestrogen products per UK SmPC) and lowers many co-medications (warfarin, DOACs, lamotrigine, valproate, etc.); conversely, CYP3A4 inhibitors (grapefruit juice, azoles, macrolides, cimetidine) raise carbamazepine levels (Tegretol US PI, PRECAUTIONS - Drug Interactions; Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, sections 4.4, 4.5, 4.6).

Never stop Tegretol abruptly in an epilepsy patient - seizures or life-threatening status epilepticus can occur; taper gradually, and cover changeover to another AED with a suitable drug (Tegretol US PI, ADVERSE REACTIONS and WARNINGS - General; Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, section 4.4).

Hyponatremia (often SIADH, dose-related) is common enough to warrant deliberate monitoring in elderly patients and those on diuretics - baseline sodium, then ~2 weeks, then monthly for 3 months (UK SmPC); signs include headache, confusion, weakness, new seizures, and unsteadiness leading to falls (Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, section 4.4; Tegretol US PI, WARNINGS - General).

Bipolar disorder: not an FDA-approved US indication for carbamazepine; the UK SmPC licenses it for prophylaxis of manic-depressive psychosis in patients unresponsive to lithium (initial 400 mg/day divided doses, usual range 400-600 mg/day, max 1600 mg/day). Do not conflate US and UK labeling (Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, section 4.1; Tegretol US PI, INDICATIONS AND USAGE).

Tegretol suspension is absorbed faster with higher peaks and lower troughs; use lower starting doses and more frequent dosing (three to four times daily), never co-administer with other liquid medications (precipitate with chlorpromazine/thioridazine solutions), and remember it carries propylene glycol (25 mg/mL) and sorbitol (avoid in hereditary fructose intolerance) (Tegretol US PI, DESCRIPTION, PRECAUTIONS, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION).

Tegretol-XR must be swallowed whole, never crushed or chewed; inspect for chips/cracks; the coating is not absorbed and may appear in stool; same total daily dose as conventional tablets, given twice daily; steady-state levels comparable to four-times-daily conventional dosing (Tegretol US PI, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION, HOW SUPPLIED and MEDICATION GUIDE).

If rash appears, stop at first sign - Tegretol should be discontinued at the first sign of a rash unless clearly not drug related; do not rechallenge after SJS/TEN, FDE/GBFDE, anaphylaxis or angioedema; expect cross-reactivity with oxcarbazepine in ~1/4 to 1/3 of carbamazepine-hypersensitive patients (Tegretol US PI, WARNINGS - Serious Dermatologic Reactions, Hypersensitivity, Anaphylaxis and Angioedema; Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, section 4.4).

Absence (petit mal) seizures are not controlled by Tegretol and mixed disorders with atypical absences may worsen - choose a different AED (Tegretol US PI, INDICATIONS AND USAGE, PRECAUTIONS - General; Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, sections 4.1 and 4.4).
black_box_warnings: SERIOUS DERMATOLOGIC REACTIONS AND HLA-B*1502 ALLELE: SERIOUS AND SOMETIMES FATAL DERMATOLOGIC REACTIONS, INCLUDING TOXIC EPIDERMAL NECROLYSIS (TEN) AND STEVENS-JOHNSON SYNDROME (SJS), HAVE BEEN REPORTED DURING TREATMENT WITH TEGRETOL. THESE REACTIONS ARE ESTIMATED TO OCCUR IN 1 TO 6 PER 10,000 NEW USERS IN COUNTRIES WITH MAINLY CAUCASIAN POPULATIONS, BUT THE RISK IN SOME ASIAN COUNTRIES IS ESTIMATED TO BE ABOUT 10 TIMES HIGHER. STUDIES IN PATIENTS OF CHINESE ANCESTRY HAVE FOUND A STRONG ASSOCIATION BETWEEN THE RISK OF DEVELOPING SJS/TEN AND THE PRESENCE OF HLA-B*1502, AN INHERITED ALLELIC VARIANT OF THE HLA-B GENE. HLA-B*1502 IS FOUND ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY IN PATIENTS WITH ANCESTRY ACROSS BROAD AREAS OF ASIA. PATIENTS WITH ANCESTRY IN GENETICALLY AT-RISK POPULATIONS SHOULD BE SCREENED FOR THE PRESENCE OF HLA-B*1502 PRIOR TO INITIATING TREATMENT WITH TEGRETOL. PATIENTS TESTING POSITIVE FOR THE ALLELE SHOULD NOT BE TREATED WITH TEGRETOL UNLESS THE BENEFIT CLEARLY OUTWEIGHS THE RISK (SEE WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS, LABORATORY TESTS). (Tegretol US PI, Boxed Warning)

APLASTIC ANEMIA AND AGRANULOCYTOSIS: APLASTIC ANEMIA AND AGRANULOCYTOSIS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE USE OF TEGRETOL. DATA FROM A POPULATION-BASED CASE CONTROL STUDY DEMONSTRATE THAT THE RISK OF DEVELOPING THESE REACTIONS IS 5 TO 8 TIMES GREATER THAN IN THE GENERAL POPULATION. HOWEVER, THE OVERALL RISK OF THESE REACTIONS IN THE UNTREATED GENERAL POPULATION IS LOW, APPROXIMATELY SIX PATIENTS PER ONE MILLION POPULATION PER YEAR FOR AGRANULOCYTOSIS AND TWO PATIENTS PER ONE MILLION POPULATION PER YEAR FOR APLASTIC ANEMIA. ALTHOUGH REPORTS OF TRANSIENT OR PERSISTENT DECREASED PLATELET OR WHITE BLOOD CELL COUNTS ARE NOT UNCOMMON IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE USE OF TEGRETOL, DATA ARE NOT AVAILABLE TO ESTIMATE ACCURATELY THEIR INCIDENCE OR OUTCOME. HOWEVER, THE VAST MAJORITY OF THE CASES OF LEUKOPENIA HAVE NOT PROGRESSED TO THE MORE SERIOUS CONDITIONS OF APLASTIC ANEMIA OR AGRANULOCYTOSIS. BECAUSE OF THE VERY LOW INCIDENCE OF AGRANULOCYTOSIS AND APLASTIC ANEMIA, THE VAST MAJORITY OF MINOR HEMATOLOGIC CHANGES OBSERVED IN MONITORING OF PATIENTS ON TEGRETOL ARE UNLIKELY TO SIGNAL THE OCCURRENCE OF EITHER ABNORMALITY. NONETHELESS, COMPLETE PRETREATMENT HEMATOLOGICAL TESTING SHOULD BE OBTAINED AS A BASELINE. IF A PATIENT IN THE COURSE OF TREATMENT EXHIBITS LOW OR DECREASED WHITE BLOOD CELL OR PLATELET COUNTS, THE PATIENT SHOULD BE MONITORED CLOSELY. DISCONTINUATION OF THE DRUG SHOULD BE CONSIDERED IF ANY EVIDENCE OF SIGNIFICANT BONE MARROW DEPRESSION DEVELOPS. (Tegretol US PI, Boxed Warning)
fields.administration_instructions: Oral. Tegretol is available as tablets of 200 mg, XR tablets of 100, 200, and 400 mg, and as a suspension of 100 mg/5 mL (teaspoon) (Tegretol US PI, DESCRIPTION). Medication should be taken with meals (Tegretol US PI, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION). Tegretol may be taken during, after or between meals, with a little liquid, e.g. a glass of water (Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, section 4.2). Suspension: yellow-orange, citrus-vanilla flavored; shake well before using; 100 mg/5 mL (teaspoon); contains propylene glycol 25 mg/mL and sorbitol; do not store above 30 degrees C (86 degrees F); dispense in tight, light-resistant container (USP); do not administer simultaneously with other liquid medicinal agents or diluents; when converting from tablets to suspension, give the same number of mg per day in smaller, more frequent doses (twice a day tablets to three times a day suspension) (Tegretol US PI, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION, DESCRIPTION, HOW SUPPLIED and MEDICATION GUIDE). Tablets 200 mg: capsule-shaped, pink, single-scored (imprinted Tegretol on one side and 27 twice on the partially scored side); store at 20 to 25 degrees C (68 to 77 degrees F), excursions permitted between 15 and 30 degrees C; protect from moisture; dispense in tight container (USP) (Tegretol US PI, HOW SUPPLIED). XR tablets: 100 mg - round, yellow, coated ('T' one side, '100 mg' other, release portal); 200 mg - round, pink, coated ('T' / '200 mg'); 400 mg - round, brown, coated ('T' / '400 mg'); must be swallowed whole and never crushed or chewed; inspect for chips or cracks; damaged tablets or tablets without a release portal should not be consumed; the coating is not absorbed and is excreted in the feces (may be noticeable in stool); store at 20 to 25 degrees C (68 to 77 degrees F), excursions permitted between 15 and 30 degrees C; protect from moisture; dispense in tight container (USP) (Tegretol US PI, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION, HOW SUPPLIED and MEDICATION GUIDE). Conversion from conventional tablets to Tegretol-XR: administer the same total daily mg dose of Tegretol-XR (Tegretol US PI, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION). Suspension absorption is faster than tablets, so patients given the suspension should be started on lower doses and increased slowly (Tegretol US PI, PRECAUTIONS - General). Epilepsy combination therapy: Tegretol may be used alone or with other anticonvulsants; when added to existing therapy, add gradually while other anticonvulsants are maintained or gradually decreased, except phenytoin, which may have to be increased (Tegretol US PI, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION - Epilepsy, Combination Therapy). Trigeminal neuralgia: attempts should be made at least once every 3 months to reduce the dose to the minimum effective level or even discontinue the drug (Tegretol US PI, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION - Trigeminal Neuralgia). UK SmPC storage: do not store above 25 degrees C; store in the original package to protect from moisture (Tegretol 100mg Tablets UK SmPC, section 6.4).
